description: This file initializes and manages database connections for different database types (sqlite, mysql, mariadb, postgres) using TypeORM. It includes environment-based configuration, SSL setup, and a singleton pattern for the DataSource instance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the DataSource based on environment variables and database type.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Returns the singleton DataSource instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getDatabaseSSLFromEnv
methods.description: Returns SSL configuration based on environment variables.
